gloss: one's own funds; personal capital; equity (as opposed to borrowed money)

definitions.gloss: one's own funds; personal capital; own-source funding
definitions.explanation: Money that belongs to the person or company using it, as opposed to money borrowed from a bank or other source. Especially common in discussions of home purchases, starting a business, or investment.

examples.japanese: {自己資金|じこしきん}が{足|た}りない。
examples.english: I don't have enough of my own funds.

examples.japanese: {自己資金|じこしきん}で{家|いえ}を{買|か}うのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: Buying a house with one's own funds alone is difficult.

examples.japanese: {事業|じぎょう}を{始|はじ}めるにあたって、ある{程度|ていど}の{自己資金|じこしきん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: To start a business, you need a certain amount of personal capital.

examples.japanese: {住宅|じゅうたく}ローンを{組|く}むには、{物件|ぶっけん}{価格|かかく}の{二割|にわり}{程度|ていど}の{自己資金|じこしきん}を{用意|ようい}しておくのが{望|のぞ}ましい。
examples.english: When taking out a home loan, it's advisable to have prepared personal funds equal to about 20% of the property price.

notes:
A financial term that distinguishes one's own money from borrowed money. Composed of {自己|じこ} (self) + {資金|しきん} (funds/capital). Commonly used in banking, real estate, and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自己資金|じこしきん}が{足|た}りる / {足|た}りない: to have (not) enough of one's own funds
- {自己資金|じこしきん}を{用意|ようい}する: to prepare one's own funds
- {自己資金|じこしきん}で{購入|こうにゅう}する: to purchase with one's own funds
- {自己資金|じこしきん}{比率|ひりつ}: equity ratio (ratio of own funds to total capital)
- {自己資金|じこしきん}ゼロ: zero down payment (no own funds)

SIMILAR WORDS / ANTONYMS:
- {借入金|かりいれきん}: borrowed money; loan — the opposite; money borrowed from a bank or other lender
- {頭金|あたまきん}: down payment — the portion of one's own funds used at the start of a large purchase
- {運転資金|うんてんしきん}: working capital — funds used for day-to-day business operations
- {資本金|しほんきん}: capital (of a company) — the registered capital of a corporation

USAGE:
When applying for a home loan or business loan in Japan, banks typically ask how much {自己資金|じこしきん} the applicant can contribute. A higher {自己資金|じこしきん} ratio usually means better loan terms.
